title: The Little Goat
summary: A little goat loves to go out walking and wandering, and one day he gets lost. How will he find his way back home?
pages: Every day, the little goat went out for a walk.
One day, the little goat couldn't find his way home.
The little goat met an ox in the barn. "Mr. Ox, do you know the way back to my home?" he asked. "I don't know. I've never been to your home," answered Mr. Ox.
The little goat kept walking and saw a bird on a branch. He asked, "Bird, do you know the way back to my home?" "I don't know. I flew here from somewhere else," answered the bird.
The little goat kept walking and met a hen. "Hen, do you know the way back to my home?" "Of course! Your home is over there, that way!" called the hen.
"Maaa, maaa, maaa! I'm so happy to see my mother."
